# Hedera testnet resources

Every id below was created by `pnpm hedera:setup` against Hedera testnet. The
script is idempotent: it reads `docs/hedera.testnet.json`, verifies each id on
the mirror node and creates only what is missing, so running it again prints
"nothing to do" and leaves this file untouched.

The block between the two markers is generated. Add new sections outside it.

## Accounts

Every account carries an ECDSA key with its EVM address set at creation, so
none of them is long-zero and all of them can pass an ECRECOVER check. Keys
are derived from the operator key with HKDF-SHA256 and the label
`creance/testnet/<role>`, so this list is reproducible from the operator key
alone and no derived key is stored anywhere. Testnet only.

| Role | Account id | EVM address | Funded HBAR | Env name | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| oracle | [0.0.10366447](https://hashscan.io/testnet/account/0.0.10366447) | `0x8aaf5b093842dc2e32f56bad9534d12a83861301` | 15 | HEDERA_ORACLE_ID | publishes ODI observations to the index topic and holds the ORACLE role |

## Tokens

Token EVM addresses are the long-zero form, which is what a Solidity call to
the HTS system contract at 0x167 takes. All settlement amounts are integers in
minor units: 28.00 TUSD is 28000000.

| Class | Name | Token id | EVM address | Decimals | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| settlement | Creance Test USD (TUSD) | [0.0.10366463](https://hashscan.io/testnet/token/0.0.10366463) | `0x00000000000000000000000000000000009e2dff` | 6 | created by this script |
| policy receipt | Creance Occupation Cover Policy (CPOL) | [0.0.10366468](https://hashscan.io/testnet/token/0.0.10366468) | `0x00000000000000000000000000000000009e2e04` | 0 | non-fungible, freeze default false |

## Topics

All four topics carry the operator key as admin key so a memo can be fixed.
The submit key is what makes a topic a settlement record: without one, anyone
on testnet can write to it.

| Topic | Topic id | EVM address | Submit key | Memo |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| index | [0.0.10366470](https://hashscan.io/testnet/topic/0.0.10366470) | `0x00000000000000000000000000000000009e2e06` | oracle key | creance index observations ODI v1 |
| payments | [0.0.10366471](https://hashscan.io/testnet/topic/0.0.10366471) | `0x00000000000000000000000000000000009e2e07` | api key | creance premium and coupon settlements |
| claims | [0.0.10366473](https://hashscan.io/testnet/topic/0.0.10366473) | `0x00000000000000000000000000000000009e2e09` | adjuster key | creance claim decisions |
| agent-journal | [0.0.10366475](https://hashscan.io/testnet/topic/0.0.10366475) | `0x00000000000000000000000000000000009e2e0b` | none, public by design | creance agent journal, public by design |

## Demo balances

Handed out by the setup script so the auto-association path is exercised
before the demo runs. The receiving accounts carry
`maxAutomaticTokenAssociations = -1`, so the first transfer consumes a slot
and the sender pays for it.

| Role | Balance | Minor units |
|---|---|---|
| policyholder-1 | 10000 TUSD | 10000000000 |
| policyholder-2 | 10000 TUSD | 10000000000 |
| policyholder-3 | 10000 TUSD | 10000000000 |
| investor-1 | 250000 TUSD | 250000000000 |
| investor-2 | 250000 TUSD | 250000000000 |

## Day 0 findings

- Freeze default true does not compose with unlimited auto-association: the transfer to the auto-associating account 0.0.10366465 failed with ACCOUNT_FROZEN_FOR_TOKEN
- NFT metadata limit measured as bytes: 100 ASCII bytes minted, 60 two-byte characters (120 bytes) failed with METADATA_TOO_LONG
- Probe collection [0.0.10366466](https://hashscan.io/testnet/token/0.0.10366466), probe account [0.0.10366465](https://hashscan.io/testnet/account/0.0.10366465).

## x402 facilitator

Blocky402 at https://api.testnet.blocky402.com lists `hedera:testnet` with fee payer
[0.0.7162784](https://hashscan.io/testnet/account/0.0.7162784). T08 proves a settlement payload against it.
